summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a company announcement dated October 12, 2026, disclosing an upward revision to full-year 2026 guidance. The London-based product tanker operator now expects 2026 TCE of USD 1,700-1,900m and EBITDA of USD 1,300-1,500m, versus prior guidance of USD 1,400-1,600m and USD 1,000-1,200m. No securities, stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are involved; this is a routine earnings-guidance update, with Q3 2026 results scheduled for November 4, 2026.
